source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus PR #14983; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: The merge querier shares one matcher slice across concurrent querier goroutines, so a querier that mutates the slice triggers a data race and can corrupt other queriers' matchers.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the tsdb package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: mergeGenericQuerier.Select passes the same shared matchers slice into multiple querier goroutines, and a querier that alters the slice in place causes a concurrent data race.

ops_fault.description: Concurrent Select across merged queriers races on a shared matcher slice, producing intermittent data races and occasional wrong query results.
localization_keywords: shared matchers slice passed to multiple goroutines
matchers captured by reference in goroutine closure
repair_keywords: copy matchers per querier before goroutine
pass matcher copy as goroutine argument
avoid aliasing the shared matchers slice

visible_context.issue_text: When querying through a merged querier backed by more than one querier, the race detector flags a data race and queries occasionally return incorrect results because one querier modifies the shared matcher slice while others read it.
